title: GeoTTER: Leveraging Local Geometry of Optimal Transport for Zero-Shot Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.13518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present GeoTTER, a novel framework that redefines optimal transport in the realm of zero-shot classification. Conventional methods often suffer from miscalibration and a lack of adaptability, as they rely on fixed cost matrices derived solely from pre-trained model embeddings. In contrast, GeoTTER addresses these limitations by incorporating two key techniques. First, to alleviate high-frequency label jaggedness (sample-level manifold jitter that assigns neighboring embeddings to different classes), GeoTTER integrates local geometric structure into the optimal transport formulation via graph-Laplacian smoothing, a technique grounded in spectral graph theory that enforces neighborhood consistency. translated_title: GeoTTER：利用最优传输的局部几何结构实现零样本分类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GeoTTER，这是一个重新定义零样本分类领域中最优传输的新颖框架。传统方法通常存在校准不佳和适应性不足的问题，因为它们依赖于仅从预训练模型嵌入中导出的固定代价矩阵。相比之下，GeoTTER通过引入两种关键技术来解决这些局限性。首先，为了缓解高频标签锯齿现象（即样本级流形抖动，将相邻嵌入分配给不同类别），GeoTTER通过图拉普拉斯平滑将局部几何结构整合到最优传输公式中，这是一种基于谱图理论的技术，能够强制执行邻域一致性。其次，为了纠正连贯的角度漂移（即大量样本与其真实标签原型共享相同角度偏移的低频方向偏差），我们将聚类引导的代价分量与全局调整项相融合（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GeoTTER通过图拉普拉斯平滑将局部几何结构融入最优传输公式，并结合聚类引导的代价校正与全局调整机制，有效解决了传统固定代价矩阵方法在零样本分类中校准不佳和适应性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: GeoTTER enhances optimal transport for zero-shot classification by incorporating local geometric structure through graph-Laplacian smoothing and combining clustering-guided cost correction with global adjustment, addressing the miscalibration and lack of adaptability in conventional methods that rely on fixed cost matrices.
